text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Hey, Trainer. I learned something recently.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hayahide showed me how to win the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, though it wore me out something crazy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: All right, Hayahide, lay it on me!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I trust you brought the notebook you've been using to keep track of your weight?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Jumping right to my measurements? You dog, you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Look, fluctuations in weight affect muscle mass and stamina, and you need to calculate your pacing based on all those…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, I get it. Here ya go.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… Well? How'd I do?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You aren't running out of breath as much as before. Seems like your trainer's emphasis on basic fitness is paying off.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But, you still aren't moving your arms enough. Your legs alone won't carry you to the finish. If I were to come up with a method just for—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Got it. Lemme write all this down.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Hayahide? What were you gonna say?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You really are serious about this, aren't you? Ever since I asked you to take notes, you've been taking them without fail.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, that's what you told me to do right from the get-go.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: All the same, I commend you for making it a habit so quickly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, you do keep asking me to explain terminology I've already explained numerous times.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's… well… Let's just say I reeeally appreciate you always explaining things to me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But just know that I'm gonna do my best, in my own dumb way!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Because… well, there are people out there who believe I can do amazing things.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …Hm.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Since you're aiming for the Tenno Sho, let me finish with this most important of lessons.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Which is?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: How to win the spring Tenno Sho—no, how to win any race. Based on my experience…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: She said to just hang in there.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: To look at the runners beside you, behind you, in front of you, and tell yourself… "I am not losing to any of them!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, the stands at Kyoto Racecourse are bustling with spectators.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wow, this year has a great lineup. I wonder if that wild one is running too.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I dunno, but Golshi's my pick for the win.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Really? Her? I don't think she's on the level to win, or even to put up a fight.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's why she's my pick! She's the only one for me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So you're finally here. We've all been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Take a look. Look at all the faces out there.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …And?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ha, you really don't get it? This is the prestigious stage of the spring Tenno Sho. So… which are you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: When you're eating fried eggs… are you team hot sauce or team soy sauce?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh, I like mayo…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ehhhhhnt!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hark! The buzzer of battle has sounded! And I won't be satisfied till I've captured you as a perfect specimen of petri dish idiocy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? I have zero idea what you mean, but can you cut it out with the scary words?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well… you're actually something yourself.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Forget about the audience. Coming out to this mountain just to become a mushroom to my bamboo shoot isn't exactly normal, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: H-huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, how about we make it a contest? Let's find out who the bigger dummy is!
